intake.description: Within-workflow decision: watch the PR review loop or run a one-shot reviewer fix.

pr_branch_preflight.description: Overlord resolves and checks out the PR's target branch before any reviewer runs, so remediation commits land on the PR branch (not trunk or a stale branch). Lists outcome names only.

github_review_loop.description: Watch the PR and remediate review feedback until a terminal condition; reviewer-return outcomes are named transitions matching the github-review-loop terminal exit_reason vocabulary.

github_reviewer_fix.description: One-shot GitHub reviewer fix pass; reviewer-return outcomes are named transitions matching the github-reviewer fix-mode exit_reason vocabulary.

review_remediation_plan.description: Cerebrate re-plans remediation when review escalates to the planner. Declares every cerebrate outcome (single|multi|brood|open_questions|blocked); a re-plan that yields steps routes to implementation. There is no brood_confirm state in this workflow, so brood/open_questions/blocked surface to the user — a PR-feedback remediation cannot fan out to a brood.

implement_next_step.description: Loop head: computes the ready set (a wave) of independent remediation steps — depends_on satisfied and file scopes mutually disjoint — via the next-wave engine. Branches to implement_step (has_next_step) while any step remains, forward to validate (all_steps_complete) when the done-set covers every step. One iteration is one wave, not one step.

implement_step.description: Overlord dispatches the whole ready wave of remediation steps as parallel agents (mixed drone/changeling from the static allowed set) in one batch, awaits all, then aggregates results with blocked > needs_replan > complete precedence. A wave of one step degrades to today's serial behavior.

checkpoint.description: Molt one checkpoint commit for the whole completed wave of remediation steps, not per step.

validate.description: Overlord runs validation and judges pass/fail before pushing remediation commits.

push_remediation.description: Push the remediation commits to the working branch's remote (no PR creation) so the in-flight review loop resumes against the updated branch.
